notes: PAP reference G33/1663. Whole three-room apartment in Tours, on the fourth floor with lift in a secured and well-maintained residence at Carrefour de Verdun. The complete advert describes an entrance, 30 m2 living and dining room, separate kitchen, two bedrooms, bathroom, shower room and separate WC. The bright south-east-facing dwelling has a south-facing balcony with a view over the Cher. Heating and water are included in the charges, the facade renovation is underway and already paid, and a large public parking area is present with an optional closed garage available separately. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 10 property photos and a publication date of 31 August 2026.
